defaults.origin: Owner-authored sword and shield animations on the stock R15 rig

BasicSwordSlash1.notes: Diagonal cut, top right to bottom left. Authored by the owner and uploaded from Studio; the KeyframeSequence is an export of the uploaded clip (AnimationClipProvider), 1.0 s.

BasicSwordSlash2.notes: Horizontal cut, left to right. Authored by the owner and uploaded from Studio; the KeyframeSequence is an export of the uploaded clip (AnimationClipProvider), 1.0 s.

BasicSwordSlash3.notes: Vertical chop, top to bottom; the chain finisher. Authored by the owner and uploaded from Studio; the KeyframeSequence is an export of the uploaded clip (AnimationClipProvider), 1.0 s.

BasicSwordIdle.notes: Sword idle, full body. Authored by the owner and uploaded from Studio; the KeyframeSequence is an export of the uploaded clip (AnimationClipProvider), 1.0 s.

BasicSwordIdleNoLegs.notes: Sword idle without legs, layered over walking and running. Authored by the owner and uploaded from Studio; the KeyframeSequence is an export of the uploaded clip (AnimationClipProvider), 1.0 s.

ShieldBlock.notes: Shield block, left arm only. Authored by the owner and uploaded from Studio; the KeyframeSequence is an export of the uploaded clip (AnimationClipProvider), 1.0 s.
